SUBSTRATE. substrate_required=false. The sample runs r.Substrate=True; our project does not and must not enable it (170 B/px GBuffer, full shader recompile, several GB of DDC). Every master used at render time is legacy-converted (StrataLegacyConversion node with the legacy pins kept): M_MS_Default_Material_VT_DynamicLayering (all rocks), M_MS_CustomFoliage* (all plants), M_RealityScan_03 (dead tree), M_MS_Surface_Material_VT (ground MICs), M_MS_Decal_Material_VT (decals after re-parent), M_MistCard, M_Leaves_Base_01. Substrate-native and therefore only migrated as saved parents: M_MS_CustomDecal_CR/CNR (re-parent the three decal MICs to M_MS_Decal_Material_VT / _NoNormalAlbedo1 in Python: set_material_instance_parent, then bind T_*_DpRM to 'Opacity' and 'Roughness'; confirm with get_texture_parameter_names) and M_WaterDrips_Base (BaseColor pin unconnected under legacy shading; connect it with MaterialEditingLibrary.connect_material_property after the copy or accept darker drips). Verification gate: open ONE migrated MIC (MI_SandstoneBoulder_03) in a -run=pythonscript session before relying on the rest; fallback Look.bImportedRocksUseProjectMaterial=true keeps the Nanite geometry with M_SW_Rock.

ROLES. Stems are exact asset names (FindMeshes: exact match wins, else first prefix match, so full names are mandatory; every stem above is unique in the migrated tree). cliff: three HugeSandstoneCliff walls + MassiveSandstoneCliff_02 (36k fallback tris, holds up if Nanite is off) + MassiveSandstoneCliff_05 (1 MB LOD-only import, use for the far rim) + CanyonSandstoneRidge_03 (skyline shoulder) - warm ochre strata of plates B1/B4. arch_rock: two sandstone boulders (fallen arch material) + MassiveTundraRockFormation_02 (the 'root' an arch grows from) + ForestRockFormation_05 (mossy, for the arch nearest the wetland). boulder: mossy family for the wetland ring (MossyForestBoulder_04/_06, LichenedForestBoulder_01 2k, NordicBoulder_02 LOD-only) + SandstoneBoulder_01 for the dry rim + SandstoneBoulder_03 reused from arch_rock at zero disk cost. river_stone: SmallStonesPack_08/_10/_12 are 0.1 MB LOD-only stones sharing one 2k set (ideal for 320 no-shadow instances) + _05 as the Nanite hero at the drinking spot. groundcover: 5 species / 7 stems (Kikuyu grass clumps = the reed stand-in when Z-scaled 1.8-2.6 in the wet band, Fern, Clover mat, WhiteWindflower as the 'new growth' accent, DeadLeaves as litter that should scale up with DroughtFactor). shrub: Elderberry_04/_06 (NoOpacity master, cheapest under VSM) + Crownbeard_03 (tallest herb, reads as reeds at distance). tree: ForestDeadTree_01 (RealityScan snag, opaque, no wind - also the drought spire) + Elderberry_08 (47 MB, shares MI_Elderberry_01) as the only cheap live canopy; TreeCount 28 -> 16-20 so half the rim is live, half snag.

MUD_PATCH (new role, not read by LoadRoles yet). SM_DryRiverBed_02 is the only cracked-mud imagery in the sample (452 instances in the sample level) and the plate-B4 floor: place it flat along the retreated shoreline (RiverCenterY +- RiverWidth*1.3-2.2, size 300-450 uu, Sink 0.05, PitchJitter 0), instance count scaled by DroughtFactor (0 in the wet state, 60-120 in drought) or spawned once with the water drop. Its unique 4k textures (T_DryRiverBed_01_BC/N, listed under ground_textures.cracked_mud_unique) are NOT seamless tileables; the terrain's own procedural cracks stay.

GROUND. ground_material and ground_material_wet are null on purpose: the sample has no ready lush ground MIC (MossyGrass/MossyRockyGround/SwampWater ship as texture sets only) and the one ready instance, MI_DryGrassDampSoil_02 (straw grass on damp soil, parent M_MS_Surface_Material_VT, params 'Albedo'/'Normal'/'ARD'/'Tiling/Offset'), is the DROUGHT look. Because Look.bUseImportedGroundMaterial defaults to true, naming it as ground_material would turn the whole valley straw in the wet state and remove the M_SW_Terrain DroughtFactor lerp, so it is exposed as ground_material_dry instead. Recommended route: Tools/make_materials.py samples the migrated tileables inside M_SW_Terrain (moss -> T_MossyGrass_01, rock/upland -> T_MossyRockyGround_01, wet band -> T_SwampWater_01, Dryness>0.5 -> T_DriedGrassOnDampSoil_01) with TextureSampleParameter2D.sampler_type = SAMPLERTYPE_VIRTUAL_COLOR / _VIRTUAL_NORMAL / _VIRTUAL_MASKS (every one of these textures is VirtualTextureStreaming=true; a plain sampler type is a compile error). Alternative: author MICs from Python (MaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew, parent M_MS_Surface_Material_VT, 'Albedo'/'Normal'/'ARD') and then point ground_material at them.

WATER. water_material is null: the sample's only water materials (M_PuddleWater, M_MudPuddle_01_PCG) are Substrate-native SingleLayerWater and render grey without Substrate. Keep M_SW_Water and feed it T_RippleNormals (two panned samples, SAMPLERTYPE_VIRTUAL_NORMAL) for broken-up SSR highlights; T_Water_01_M is the puddle mask for a Python MD_DEFERRED_DECAL puddle whose size shrinks with DroughtFactor; the SwampWater set gives the amber-brown shallows under the plane.

DECALS ('decals' key is not consumed by C++ yet; use UGameplayStatics::SpawnDecalAtLocation, cap 200, FadeStartDelay/FadeDuration). TileableLeakage_01 = dark damp ground / drying-pool rings at the water edge (fade with DroughtFactor); AridDebris_01 = dry plant debris spawned when DroughtFactor > 0.5; TileableMossPatches_01 = moss on the wet-band banks (plate B2). All three need the re-parent described under SUBSTRATE; set UsePOM=false on the master. Decals only show on opaque receivers, which the PMC terrain is.

WIND. MF_SimpleWind reads MPC_GlobalFoliageActor ('Wind Strength', 'Wind Speed', 'Wind Strength Plants', 'Wind Speed Plants', 'Wind Tiling', 'Wind Noise', vector 'Wind Direction', plus 'Season Strength/Brightness/Saturation'); the sample drives it from a Blueprint that is not migrated, so set the scalars once from C++ (UKismetMaterialLibrary::SetScalarParameterValue on the migrated MPC) or accept static plants; 'Season Strength' is a text-authored drought lever.

VIRTUAL TEXTURES. Every Megascans texture here is VirtualTextureStreaming=true and the masters sample SAMPLERTYPE_Virtual*; r.VirtualTextures defaults to 1 in 5.7 (no ini change), VT pools are separate from r.Streaming.PoolSize - copy the sample's [/Script/Engine.VirtualTexturePoolConfig] block into Config/DefaultEngine.ini only if VT pool warnings appear.

PLATE MAPPING. B1 (sun behind two arches, mist pooled over the wetland, amber river, furrows + sprouts): sandstone cliffs/ridge, arch rocks, mist cards, SwampWater shallows, WhiteWindflower/Clover sprouts, TileableLeakage wet ground. B2 (mossy rocky stream, Lumen drinking): mossy boulders, LichenedForestBoulder, SmallStonesPack, Kikuyu/Fern/Crownbeard reeds, TileableMossPatches.
